verses.text: The heads of the Levite families came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the family leaders of Israel’s tribes. 👥
They spoke to them at Shiloh in Canaan: ‘Yahweh commanded through Moses that we receive towns to live in, with pastureland for our livestock.’ 🗣️
So Israel gave the Levites towns from their own inheritances, with pastures, just as Yahweh commanded. 🏘️
The first lot went to Kohath’s families. Aaron’s priestly descendants, who were Levites, received thirteen towns from Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin. 🎲
The rest of Kohath’s descendants received ten towns from Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh’s tribe. 🏘️
Gershon’s descendants received thirteen towns from Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and half of Manasseh in Bashan. 🏘️
Merari’s descendants received twelve towns from Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun. 🏘️
Israel gave these towns and pastures to the Levites by lot, just as Yahweh had commanded through Moses. 🎲
From Judah and Simeon, they gave the following towns, called out by name: 📜
They went to Aaron’s descendants from Kohath’s families, Levi’s descendants. They got the first lot. 🎲
They gave them Kiriath-arba, named after Anak’s father and also called Hebron, in Judah’s hill country, with its surrounding pastureland. 🏔️
But Caleb son of Jephunneh kept the town’s fields and villages as his own property. 🏡
They gave Aaron’s priestly descendants Hebron and its pastures—the refuge city for anyone who had accidentally killed someone—and Libnah with its pastures; 🛡️
Jattir and its pastures, Eshtemoa and its pastures; 🏘️
Holon and its pastures, Debir and its pastures; 🏘️
Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, each with pastureland—nine towns from those two tribes altogether. 🏘️
From Benjamin’s tribe they got Gibeon and its pastures, and Geba and its pastures; 🏘️
Anathoth and Almon, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
Aaron’s priestly descendants had thirteen towns in all, each with its pastureland. 🏘️
The rest of Kohath’s Levite families got their lot of towns from Ephraim’s tribe. 🎲
They gave them Shechem and its pastures in Ephraim’s hill country—the refuge city for anyone who had accidentally killed someone—and Gezer with its pastures; 🛡️
Kibzaim and Beth-horon, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From Dan’s tribe they got Elteke and Gibbethon, each with its pastureland; 🏘️
Aijalon and Gath-rimmon, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From half of Manasseh’s tribe they got Taanach and Gath-rimmon, each with pastureland—two towns. 🏘️
The rest of Kohath’s families had ten towns altogether, each with its pastures. 🏘️

From half of Manasseh’s tribe, Gershon’s Levite families got Golan in Bashan and its pastures—the refuge city for anyone who had accidentally killed someone—and Be-eshterah with its pastures. Two towns. 🛡️
From Issachar’s tribe: Kishion and Daberath, each with pastureland; 🏘️
Jarmuth and En-gannim, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From Asher’s tribe: Mishal and Abdon, each with pastureland; 🏘️
Helkath and Rehob, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From Naphtali’s tribe they got Kedesh in Galilee and its pastures—the refuge city for anyone who had accidentally killed someone—plus Hammoth-dor and Kartan with their pastures. Three towns. 🛡️
The Gershonite families had thirteen towns altogether, each with its pastureland. 🏘️
From Zebulun’s tribe, Merari’s Levite families—the rest of Levi’s descendants—got Jokneam and Kartah, each with pastureland; 🏘️
Dimnah and Nahalal, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From Reuben’s tribe they got Bezer and Jahaz, each with pastureland; 🏘️
Kedemoth and Mephaath, each with pastureland—four towns altogether. 🏘️
From Gad’s tribe they got Ramoth in Gilead and its pastures—the refuge city for anyone who had accidentally killed someone—and Mahanaim with its pastures; 🛡️
Heshbon and Jazer with their pastures—four towns altogether. 🏘️
Those were all the towns allotted to Merari’s families, the rest of the Levites. Their lot was twelve towns. 🏘️
All the Levite towns inside Israel’s territory added up to forty-eight, each with surrounding pastureland. 🏘️
Every one of those towns had pastureland around it. That was the setup for all of them. 🌿
So Yahweh gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors. They took possession and settled there. 🏡
Yahweh gave them peace on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. None of their enemies could stand against them; Yahweh handed every enemy over to them. 🛡️
Not one good promise Yahweh made to Israel’s people fell through. Every word came true. ✅
